name: Priolo Gargallo (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Priolo Gargallo (a cockerel on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Priolo Gargallo, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 28 August 1980.

features.role: Priolo Gargallo arms — cockerel on red, crowned, within branches
